title: Governed state transition: advance <instance> <dossier> binds an APPROVED dossier; the instance's gate is derived from the chain
objective: Let an instance move beyond G00 only as a derived consequence of a bound, still-valid, APPROVED dossier for its next gate -- the same derive-and-corroborate pattern as landed_as and the charter.
business_value: Today a gate passing changes nothing anywhere; G01 (Issue #41) and every later gate need this substrate before their contracts mean anything.
in_scope: advance <instance> <dossier> (validates instance first; dossier must render APPROVED/APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS, name the instance's WP, be for the NEXT gate; bound byte-identical under badf/evidence/dossiers/; state re-derived; lock re-signed)
derive_state lifecycle from the chain; validate_instance re-validates every bound dossier against its framework original and requires contiguity
tests in scratch instances incl. an APPROVED G00 fixture; mutation; compose
acceptance_criteria: fresh instance: advance with the HELD init dossier is refused
an APPROVED G00 dossier advances the instance to G00 / APPROVED; instance re-derives it
a G01 dossier is refused before G00 is bound (contiguity) and accepted after
a bound copy that differs from the framework original is refused; a framework original that no longer renders APPROVED is refused
a dossier for another WP, or for a gate that is not next, is refused
hand-edited lifecycle after re-sign is refused
advance writes only the bound dossier, state.json and the lockfile
permissions: write: scratch instances under tmp only

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Decision BADF-DEC-0007 is delegated and says so.
